strings.srclabel: FOCUS - paste a phrase, grammar point, kanji, question, image, or notes
strings.srcph: e.g. 食べたい, は vs が, a lesson file path, or "I want to order coffee politely"
strings.chip_img: image focus: {name} ({kb} KB) · needs a vision model
strings.empty: Load a focus and press Teach. Tsuki handles sound and use; Selene handles pattern, nuance, and memory.
strings.st_loadsrc: Load a focus first, then start the lesson.
strings.st_srcloaded: Focus loaded. Choose a path and teach the lesson.
strings.browser_banner: Browser preview. File reads, voice synthesis, and VRAM telemetry need the Electron app. Raw text and LLM calls may still work.
strings.loadmodel_title: Load the selected model in LM Studio
strings.st_loadelectron: Loading a model needs the Electron app.
strings.st_loadlocal: Model loading is available for LM Studio local mode.
strings.privacy_local: Local provider: your lesson material stays on this computer.
strings.privacy_cloud: Cloud provider: submitted lesson material is sent to the selected service.
strings.hardware_cloud: A cloud provider does not load a model on this computer.
strings.hardware_unknown: Memory could not be measured. New model loading is locked for safety.
strings.hardware_ready: {gpu}: {vram} GiB VRAM free · {ram} GiB RAM free.
strings.model_required: Choose a downloaded model first. Gengo Duet never chooses one automatically.
strings.model_loaded_external: {model} is already loaded in LM Studio.
strings.model_fit_safe: {model} passes the safety limit: estimate {need} GiB; safe headroom {available} GiB.
strings.model_fit_unknown: Load blocked: Gengo Duet could not verify the memory needed by {model}.
strings.model_fit_blocked: Blocked for safety: {model} estimate {need} GiB; safe headroom {available} GiB.
strings.model_not_loaded: {selected} is not ready. Open settings and use the load button first.
strings.catalog_unavailable: Gengo Duet could not read LM Studio's model list. Start its server and try again.
